'''Millius Prime''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iego/Legends|Iego]] and the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Diathim/Legends|Diathim]].

==History==
[[File:Angel1.png|thumb|left|180px|Diathim, the original inhabitants of Millius Prime.]]
Millius Prime was originally inhabited by the [[Diathim/Legends|Diathim]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] invaded the moon and took it over. They set up a [[LaserWeb Defense Station/Legends|laser field]] to prevent anyone leaving the system, causing the planetary orbit around Iego to become home to a ship graveyard. The stranded inhabitants of Iego believed the laser grid to be the god [[Drol/Legends|Drol]].

===Inhabits===
The Daithim were a peaceful people as claimed by one of [[Diathim refugee/Legends|their own]].
When the Separatist drove the angels from their homes, Millius
Prime was abandoned. After stranded Jedi [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] destroyed the [[LaserWeb Defense Station/Legends|LaserWeb Defense Station]] surrounding Iego, known to the locals as [[Drol/Legends|Drol]] or the Ghost of Drol, it is presumed that the Diathim returned to Millius Prime.
